title: Master of Wolpertingers (1517)
problem: One 50% roll for +1 cast, once per cast call. Nothing repeats it. Text: "This effect can occur multiple times in a row."
notes: In-game test: Master of Wolpertingers: cast Scourge spells many times; the extra Scourge cast can repeat (chain of 50% rolls, at most 14 extra). Community claim: The extra Scourge cast can't repeat. Evidence: bc_CreatureCast: scr_Roll(50) @0x14074756f; Scourge ids 166-170 @0x1407475ba-0x140747708; gates @0x1407478f9 / 0x140747c98; += 1 @0x140747eb4. Fix sketch: Loop the roll (H), or remove the sentence (T). Triage 2026-10-26: One 50% roll; 'can occur multiple times in a row' is not implemented. Hook: repeat the roll while it succeeds.

release_notes.intended: Scourge spells have a 50% chance to be cast 1 additional time, which can happen several times in a row.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, there was only one roll.
release_notes.fix: Now the roll repeats while it keeps succeeding.
